entry.title: HAIFA SMOKED FISH Recalls Cold Smoked Sprats Due to Potential Health Risk
entry.summary: HAIFA SMOKED FISH of QUEENS NY is recalling approximately 560 lbs. of Cold Smoked Sprats, due to potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum, a bacterium which can cause life-threatening illness. Consumers are warned not to use the product even if it does not look or smell spoiled.
